title: The Road to Bikini
author: Rachel S.
desc:
**4 Weeks to Stronger Glutes & a Bikini-Built Physique. 🍑**

Designed to build the curves, strength, and definition that create a balanced bikini bodybuilding physique.

This 4-week training program combines **3 glute-focused sessions with targeted upper-body training** to develop fuller, rounder glutes, sculpted shoulders, and a strong, feminine silhouette.

With intentional exercise selection, progressive overload, and a focus on proper execution, every workout is designed to help you train smarter, build muscle where it matters, and bring your physique goals to life.

Train with purpose. Build with intention. Sculpt your strongest physique yet.

elevate feet on plates or small box, or do on floor to start. No weight, bodyweight to failure
